name: Commercial Steak Doneness & Cooking Chart
primary_keyword: commercial steak doneness cooking temperature chart
secondary_keywords: rare medium well done steak temperatures
steak resting time and temperature rise
search_intent: Steakhouses, gastro-pubs, and restaurant grill chefs needing definitive internal core temperatures, surface searing rules, probe protocols, and resting guidance for Blue (45°C), Rare (50–52°C), Medium-Rare (54–57°C), Medium (60–63°C), Medium-Well (65–68°C), and Well-Done (71–75°C) intact whole-muscle beef steaks under UK food hygiene regulations.

competitors.title: Steak Doneness Temperature Guide | Serious Eats
competitors.strengths: Detailed food science exploration of muscle protein denaturation.
competitors.weaknesses: Consumer-oriented, narrative blog, US Fahrenheit only, lacks commercial catering HACCP/EHO context.

competitors.title: Steak Doneness Temperatures & Resting Guide | ThermoWorks
competitors.weaknesses: Static image, built to sell thermometer hardware, no interactive cooking calculator.

competitors.title: How to Cook the Perfect Steak | Hawksmoor
competitors.weaknesses: Informal prose, lacks downloadable technical chart or statutory regulatory details on intact vs pinned steaks.

competitors.title: How to Cook the Perfect Steak | BBC Good Food
competitors.weaknesses: Domestic kitchen tips, misses commercial flat-top/char-grill searing temperatures and probe hygiene.

competitors.title: Steak Doneness Guide & Temperatures | Steaks and Game
competitors.strengths: Clear descriptions of firmness and doneness.
competitors.weaknesses: US units, heavy display ads, no digital tools or EHO compliance guidance.

gap_analysis.what_they_have: Basic doneness descriptions and Fahrenheit cooking times.
gap_analysis.what_they_lack: An interactive digital chart with core vs pull temperatures, carry-over heat calculations, probe positioning standards, and UK FSA surface searing regulatory compliance.
gap_analysis.what_we_offer: Digital interactive steak temperature tool with 6 doneness stages, intact muscle safety rationale, touch test comparison, and instant A4 kitchen pass print layout.
